display_long_description:
Explore a calm underwater world created for learning through gentle, low-pressure play.
Minifunkids Immersive Ocean includes four ocean-themed VR activities that encourage attention, visual matching, direction recognition and object classification. Clear instructions, simple interactions and a peaceful visual environment make the experience easy to understand and comfortable to explore.
The app is designed for mixed-age audiences aged 10 and over and was created with neurodivergent learners and users with special educational needs in mind. It can be enjoyed at home or used as a supportive educational resource by families, educators and professionals.
Key features:
Four guided VR activities
Calm underwater environment
Simple and intuitive interactions
No chat or advertising
No in-app purchases
No external account required
Minifunkids Immersive Ocean is an educational VR experience. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, medical treatment or therapy.
Minifunkids Immersive Ocean is not directed to children under 10 years of age.
